name: RepairBench — Device Repair Shop
description: An electronics repair shop workflow: intake devices and customers, run repair jobs through a full diagnosis-to-pickup pipeline, order parts, and sign off quality checks. Includes 6 forms and 1 app.

packMeta.name: RepairBench — Device Repair Shop
packMeta.description: A workshop manager for an electronics and device repair shop: register customers and their devices, run repair jobs through a status pipeline from intake to collection, and track parts orders and final quality checks — all linked together.
packMeta.author: FormLogic

forms.title: Customer
forms.description: Add a customer with contact details and how they prefer to hear about their repair.

fields.label: New Customer
fields.description: Capture the customer details so their devices and repairs stay traceable to one person.

properties.placeholder: Previous repairs, warranty cover, how they found the shop…

forms.title: Technician
forms.description: Add a bench technician with the skills they cover and whether they are taking jobs.

fields.label: New Technician
fields.description: Add a technician and the skills they cover so jobs land on the right bench.

forms.title: Device
forms.description: Register a device against its owner, with type, identifiers and condition on arrival.

fields.label: New Device
fields.description: Register the device and its condition on arrival so every repair traces back to it.

properties.placeholder: Scratches, dents, cracked glass, prior repairs…

forms.title: Repair Job
forms.description: Open a repair job for a device, with the issue, status, priority, quote and due date.

fields.label: New Repair Job
fields.description: Open a job for a device on the bench: the fault, the fix, who owns it and when it is due back.

properties.placeholder: Fault details, passcode arrangements, customer approvals…

forms.title: Parts Order
forms.description: Order a part for a repair job and track its supplier, cost, status and ETA.

fields.label: New Parts Order
fields.description: Log the part a repair is waiting on so nothing stalls quietly on the bench.

forms.title: Quality Check
forms.description: Record the final test pass for a repair job before the device is handed back.

fields.label: New Quality Check
fields.description: Run the final test pass and record exactly what was checked before hand-back.

properties.placeholder: What was tested, anything the customer should know…

apps.name: RepairBench
apps.description: A bench operations hub for a device repair shop: intake customers and devices, run repair jobs from diagnosis to hand-back, and keep parts orders and quality checks moving from one dashboard.

roles.name: Shop Owner

roles.name: Front Counter

blocks.title: Repair bench overview
blocks.body: This report summarises the state of the repair bench: how many jobs are in the shop, where they sit in the pipeline, which faults dominate the intake and how much work is quoted. Use it for the weekly bench meeting and to spot bottlenecks before they cost a due date.
